#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MD = 998244353;
int** ch;

void init(int n) {
    ch = new int*[n + 1];
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
        ch[i] = new int[i + 1];
    }
    ch[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        ch[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++)
            ch[i][j] = (ch[i - 1][j] + ch[i - 1][j - 1]) % MD;
    }
}

long long power(long long a, int k) {
    if (k == 0)
        return 1;
    long long p = power(a, k / 2);
    p = p * p % MD;
    if (k % 2 == 1)
        p = p * a % MD;
    return p;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k, l;
    cin >> n >> k >> l;
    init(n);
    std::vector<long long> pp(2 * n + 1, 0), qq(2 * n + 1, 0), aa(2 * n + 1, 0);
    pp[n] = power(2, n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        for (int j = 2 * n; j > 0; j--) {
            pp[j] = (pp[j] - pp[j - 1]) % MD;
        }
    }
    for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * n; j++) {
        aa[j] = pp[j];
    }
    long long inv2 = (MD + 1) / 2;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n - k; i++) {
        // qq := pp / p, where p = 2x (1 - x)
        // divide by 2x
        for (int j = 0; j < 2 * n; j++) {
            qq[j] = pp[j + 1] * inv2 % MD;
        }
        qq[2 * n] = 0;
        // divide by 1 - x is multiply by 1 + x + x^2 + x^3 + ...
        for (int j = 1; j <= 2 * n; j++) {
            qq[j] = (qq[j] + qq[j - 1]) % MD;
        }
        // pp := pp * (1 - p) / p = qq - pp
        for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * n; j++) {
            pp[j] = (qq[j] - pp[j]) % MD;
        }
        long long a = ch[n][i];
        for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * n; j++) {
            aa[j] = (aa[j] + a * pp[j]) % MD;
        }
    }
    // integrate x^i to x^{i + 1} / (i + 1)
    long long a = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * n; i++) {
        a = (a + aa[i] * power(i + 1, MD - 2)) % MD;
    }
    a = (a * l % MD + MD) % MD;
    cout << a << "\n";
    return 0;
}
